snippet.title: Session: Skate Sim - Paris DLC Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
Bonjour! It's time to grab a coffee and a petit croissant.

Skate the iconic spots of Paris with our new DLC for Session: Skate Sim! Experience the City of Light while boarding across iconic locations like the Eiffel Tower or the Trocadéro soaking in the stunning visuals while enjoying Session's immersive gameplay.

Perfect your tricks at famous locations and discover hidden gems. Dive into the Parisian skate scene today!

Available now on Playstation 4 & Playstation 5.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #sessionskatesim
